questions.stem: What do all electromagnetic waves have in common?

options.text: They all have the same wavelength
They all travel at the same speed in a vacuum
They all need a medium to travel through
They all have the same frequency

questions.explanation: All electromagnetic waves travel at the same speed in a vacuum: the speed of light, approximately 3 x 10^8 m/s. They differ in wavelength and frequency but share this common speed, and they do not need a medium to travel.
